title: Tunisian Beef Tagine
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Tunisia, made with tender beef and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most spice shops or online

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a good quality olive oil

ingredients.name: tomato paste
ingredients.notes: optional, for added depth of flavor

instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a large Dutch oven or tagine over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots, potatoes, broth, tomato paste, and spice blend to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the stew at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve over couscous or rice, if desired.
